source.original_text:
Attributed ASTIS background completion, not a verbatim numbered paper theorem.
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. The laws μ,J,ν are probabilities. There exists a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized density is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)), with Λ.IsCondKernel S and Λ.fst=Λ.snd=ν. There exists a bounded selfadjoint T on the actual real L²(ν) such that for every u, ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere, and ∫Tu dν=∫u dν. Its full scalar defect D=I−T² is positive. There exists a bounded positive REAL Γ with Γ²=D and for EVERY scalar u, ‖Γu‖²=‖u‖²−‖Tu‖². Probability, kernel, T, D positivity and Γ are conclusions; no supplied CFC/root/commutation or finite-dimensional L² certificate is assumed. This is the scalar precursor to the printed joint/macro root and B.11, which remain separate.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
        IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
          (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
          (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
        ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T).IsPositive ∧
        ∃ Γ : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
          Γ.IsPositive ∧ Γ*Γ = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) ∧
          ∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖Γ u‖^2 = ‖u‖^2-‖T u‖^2
decoder_context: The base is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including zero dimension. ContDiff of order2 means C2, with both displayed global iterated Frechet-Hessian bounds and positive ordered curvature/capped step.

Measure.tilted denotes normalized exponential tilting. The displayed joint is the pushforward of the independent product with the standard Gaussian; its marginal is the second-coordinate law. Kernel normalization, measurability, disintegration and both stationary marginals are conclusions.

Lp exponent2 denotes AE square-integrable real quotient classes on the actual marginal. The kernel density is identified at every state; the operator conditional integral holds per observable almost everywhere. Mean preservation and contraction are conclusions.

Bounded real operator multiplication is composition. Positivity includes selfadjointness. The actual operator, its positive squared defect and positive REAL square root are produced conclusions. Energy is for every scalar class; no root, CFC, extension, finite L2 or operator certificate is a hypothesis.

theorem actual_positive_real_defect_root
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
        IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
          (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
          (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
        ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T).IsPositive ∧
        ∃ Γ : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
          Γ.IsPositive ∧ Γ*Γ = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) ∧
          ∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖Γ u‖^2 = ‖u‖^2-‖T u‖^2 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
  let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
    (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
  let ν := J.snd
  have hBase := CenteredDefectOperator.actual_centered_selfadjoint_defect
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  rcases hBase with ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,S,hS,hSd,hSc,hSf,hSs,U,hU,hUi,hUs,M,hM,T,hTs,hAll,
    q,hq,hTq,hqi,hzero,hD,hRest⟩
  obtain ⟨Γ,hΓ,hΓSq,hEnergy⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2RealSquareRoot.exists_positive_real_square_root
      ν ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) hD
  refine ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,S,hS,hSd,hSc,hSf,hSs,T,hTs,?_,hD,Γ,hΓ,hΓSq,?_⟩
  · intro u
    exact (hAll u).2.2
  · intro u
    rw [hEnergy]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, inner_sub_left]
    have hs : inner ℝ (T (T u)) u = inner ℝ (T u) (T u) := hTs.isSymmetric (T u) u
    rw [hs,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.RealDefectRoot

steps.title: Produce the genuine reflected kernel and scalar defect
steps.text: The independently verified centered-defect producer under the displayed original potential and step assumptions supplies probability μ,J,ν, the every-state normalized Markov S, genuine disintegration with both stationary marginals, and the same selfadjoint contractive mean-preserving T with AE conditional action. It proves D=I−T² positive internally, including the nontrivial constant mode; no caller operator or positivity certificate is used.

steps.title: Apply the shared real-root theorem to that same defect
steps.text: Apply the generic theorem to the actual marginal ν and the produced D. Its internally constructed positive real Γ satisfies Γ²=I−T². This supplies the real scalar root even when L² is infinite-dimensional and includes rank-zero base geometry and the legal αη=1 endpoint.

steps.title: Identify the scalar norm defect
steps.text: For every scalar observable u, root energy equals ⟨(I−T²)u,u⟩. Selfadjointness of the same T gives ⟨T²u,u⟩=‖Tu‖²; thus ‖Γu‖²=‖u‖²−‖Tu‖². The anonymous actual-input Test also checks ‖Γu‖≤‖u‖. This is a scalar B.11 precursor. Printed joint ΓP still requires the same onto M, restriction to ran(P) and the typed B*B identity; no full-space inverse is claimed.
